 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz Cristy Fermin appears before NBI over Claudine Barretto cyber libel complaint 
 By GMA News Published November 9, 2026 3:13pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Courtesy: File Photo, Claudine Barretto/Facebook Cristy Fermin appeared before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Cybercrime Division in Pasay City on Monday.
 The showbiz columnist appeared after she received a subpoena in relation to a cyber libel complaint filed against her and her program co-host Romel Chika or Romel Villamor by actress Claudine Barretto.
 According to GMA News' Marisol Abdurahman, Cristy said she appeared to show respect to the NBI and will only comment when the case is filed in the prosecutor’s office. She also did not confirm or deny Claudine’s allegations.
 Asked for a message to the actress, Cristy said, “Merry Christmas and Happy New Year.”

 In the subpoena dated October 26, which was shared by GMA News' John Consulta on Sunday, Cristy was “commanded” to appear at the agency's cybercrime division on November 9 to give her evidence in a certain investigation.
 Claudine filed a cyber libel complaint against Cristy in October, according to a report on “ Fast Talk with Boy Abunda .”
 Tito Boy reported that Claudine's last straw was Cristy’s alleged continuous defamation against her since the past year.
 The actress also said that Cristy has said severe words against her, compared to other stars like Bea Alonzo and Sharon Cuneta , who filed cyber libel complaints against Cristy in 2024. Dominic Roque , Bea's former fiancé, also filed a complaint against the host that same year. 
 Bea has already withdrawn her case against Cristy after the host posted an apology on her vlog. 
 Cristy has said she is prepared to face Claudine's complaint.
 —Nika Roque/CDC, GMA News
